# Ayaana Perelygina — Lead Web Designer

> Ayaana Perelygina (Айаана Перелыгина) is a Lead Web Designer with 6 years of experience designing websites for B2B and SaaS companies, the last 2 years as the web lead at an international design studio. Open to Web Design Team Lead / Lead Web Designer roles, remote or with relocation. Based in Yakutsk, Russia (UTC+9). Languages: Russian (native), English (B2).

## What she does

- Builds design processes: how a project goes from brief to release, who owns what, where rules and context live
- Owns design quality: design reviews, design systems, shared standards across projects
- Leads web designers and illustrators: assigns tasks, reviews layouts, gives feedback
- Brings AI into design team workflows: design systems documented for AI, DESIGN.md, design tokens, handoff to Lovable
- Designs websites and builds them in Tilda and Webflow

## Experience

- 2024–2026 — busy studio (international design studio), Lead Web Designer: web direction, websites and design systems for clients in Europe, the UAE and Russia; led designers on projects; brought AI into the studio's processes; built a proposal generator that managers use without a designer
- 2023–2024 — 27flows (digital studio), Senior Web Designer
- 2022–2023 — Beauty Alliance (marketing agency), Web Designer and Tilda Developer
- 2020–2022 — Freelance web designer

## Case studies

- [SegmentStream](https://ayafester.github.io/en/cases/segmentstream.html): A website for a marketing analytics SaaS platform that grows with the product. Her part: One page of the website, then leading the team.
- [Fraxis](https://ayafester.github.io/en/cases/fraxis.html): A multi-page catalog website for a cable assembly manufacturer. Her part: Structure, design and build of the catalog website.
- [BRS](https://ayafester.github.io/en/cases/brs.html): A minimalist Webflow website for a Dubai renovation company. Her part: One page of the website, then leading a web designer.
- [vet_workshop](https://ayafester.github.io/en/cases/vet-workshop.html): A new identity and website redesign for the largest online school for veterinarians. Her part: New identity, redesign of the home page, catalog and course templates.
- [Bravestone](https://ayafester.github.io/en/cases/bravestone.html): A website for a real estate agency in Portugal. Her part: Website design.
- [Neon Insights](https://ayafester.github.io/en/cases/neon-insights.html): An identity from scratch and a marketing website for a data and AI consultancy. Her part: Identity from scratch, website design and Webflow build.
- [JoomPro](https://ayafester.github.io/en/cases/joompro.html): A new marketing website for a service that sources and delivers goods from China. Her part: Website redesign.

## Skills and tools

Figma, Webflow (CMS), Tilda (Zero Block), Lovable, Claude Code, Codex, HTML + CSS, Photoshop, Illustrator, Notion. Design systems, UI kits, prototyping, responsive design, UX (user flows, CJM, personas), developer handoff.
